info.name: Task Management API
info.description:
Laravel 12 REST API for projects and tasks.

Setup:
1. Import this collection and the `Task Management API — Local` environment.
2. Run `Authentication > Login Demo User`. The token is saved automatically.
3. Run `Projects > List Projects` once, which stores the seeded project ids used by the Tasks folder.

Every folder can then be run top to bottom without destroying the seeded dataset.
